review_roles: A1 Learning Standards and Bilingual QA
review_scope: Stage 4 P0-stack method submission after rework 2, independently rechecked on resubmitted hashes

independent_findings.observed_problem: All five briefs repeat the same generic normal_case, boundary_case and failure_case. The learning questions, event lists and state lists are pattern-specific, but the three required cases do not tell Stage 7 which concrete state and misconception to visualise.
contract_basis: STAGE4_MASTER_PLAN.md requires a normal, boundary and failure case for each preliminary visual brief.
GATE_CHECKLIST.md requires A5 to challenge normal, boundary and counterexample behaviour before pilot PASS.
WORK_ORDERS.md requires visual state/event intent to be derived from confirmed method steps and error rows.

required_result.STACK_SETUP: Name a valid initial state for each top convention, a capacity-one/initial-cell boundary, and a mixed-convention or capacity-versus-last-index failure.
required_result.STACK_PUSH: Name a successful push with its exact write/move order, the one-free-slot and full boundaries, and a full-call or copied-order failure with unchanged-state evidence.
required_result.STACK_POP: Name a successful LIFO pop, the one-item and empty boundaries, and a wrong-read-index/sentinel/mutating-empty failure.
required_result.STACK_PAIR: Name the both-live commit, the both-empty boundary, and both one-sided failure cases with the exact rollback target and no sentinel push.
required_result.STACK_REDUCE: Name a multi-token fold/extrema case, a single-live-value boundary, and counterexamples for reversed non-commutative operands, sentinel-as-data and zero-initialised extrema.

independent_findings.recheck_method: Regenerate the submission, confirm that the five English and five Vietnamese normal/boundary/failure triples are pattern-specific, rerun both validators, then inspect the changed VISUAL_BRIEFS.json hash.

closure_evidence.semantic_recheck: PASS: every pattern now has a distinct bilingual normal, boundary and failure case tied to its own state transition, invariant or misconception.

review_matrix.evidence: Stable joins, bilingual student-facing fields, ordered method steps, action/why/check, invariant, guard and termination roles are present. Top-pointer, rollback and reduction decisions are explicit.
Next-free/current-top equations and update order are separated; exact result/sentinel contracts remain source-dependent; all four pair outcomes and both reduction protocols have decision rules.
Every row has consequence, detection and repair. Official rows have locators; AlgoCore risks are labelled and do not claim a fixed mark loss.
Contracts, invariants, mutation/preservation rules, termination, failure paths, alternatives and Stage 5 test obligations are present; all statuses remain PENDING_STAGE5_EXECUTION_VERIFICATION.
Each pattern has one primary official anchor plus contrast/boundary microcases and no executable-code, trace or runtime-output claim.
5/5 briefs now use distinct bilingual normal/boundary/failure cases tied to setup equations, Push mutation order, Pop LIFO/sentinel, Pair commit/rollback, and Reduce fold/extrema contracts.
